nodes.text: #166 : [Er90b] [Er91] [Er93,p.339] [Er97c] [Va99,3.51] graph theory | ramsey theory Spencer [Sp77] proved\[R(4,k) \gg (k\log k)^{5/2}.\]Ajtai, Komlós, and Szemerédi [AKS80] proved\[R(4,k) \ll \frac{k^3}{(\log k)^2}.\]This is true, and was proved by Mattheus and Verstraete [MaVe23] , who showed that\[R(4,k) \gg \frac{k^3}{(\log k)^4}.\]This problem is #5 in Ramsey Theory in the graphs problem collection. See also [986] for the general case.
